title: BandPC: Learning Residual-Band Preconditioner Combinations for Flexible Conjugate Gradient Solvers
summary: The conjugate gradient (CG) method is a classical iterative solver for sparse symmetric positive definite (SPD) linear systems, but its convergence strongly depends on the spectral properties of the system matrix. Preconditioning can improve these properties; however, designing preconditioners that generalize across diverse and irregular sparsity patterns remains challenging. We propose BandPC (Band Preconditioner Combinations, where "Band" denotes residual-norm bands), a data-driven framework that leverages graph neural networks (GNNs) to predict multi-stage preconditioning strategies for…
